tests: P4: a property whose name starts with "on" is dropped, and the add-in is told nothing
steps:
1. Open on-property-ignored.twinproj in the twinBASIC IDE and build it (win32). Copy Build\OnPropertyIgnored_win32.dll into %APPDATA%\twinBASIC\addins\win32\, restart the IDE and open any project.
2. Click the toolbar button on property repro. A tool window opens with [property] and [inline], and the DEBUG CONSOLE prints onclick set, error 0.
3. Click [property]. Expected: its text changes to clicked, or step 2 raised an error. Actual: nothing happens; the element has no onclick handler and no onclick attribute.
4. Control: click [inline]. Its text changes to clicked.
Asserted on BETA 995 and 997 by `addin-test.bat --only panes` (P4, the PanesProbe add-in in test/addin/probes/panes, of which this project is a cut-down copy).
